dev.caption: The board: profile with level, rank and XP bar on the left, the prioritised task pipeline on the right.
Queue: new requests wait here, ordered by urgency (drag to reorder). A developer accepts one to lock it in.
Completed work waits for the manager's approval. Approved tasks pay out XP by difficulty.
Creating a task: difficulty sets the XP, with voice-note instructions and file or video attachments.
All tasks with status, difficulty, assignee and the dates each stage was reached.

sales.caption: Company KPIs for the month (total and eligible sales, deals, target vs achievement, pipeline) and ranked sales teams.
Top salespeople leaderboard; every card opens that person's drill-down.
CRM pipeline split by opportunity type and by lead stage.
Team performance: weekly, quarterly, yearly and till-date targets against achievement.

marketing.caption: Weekly management report: headline KPIs, status-rated management summary and the overall health score.
Division performance: traffic, enquiries, qualified leads, sales and target achievement.
SEO targets vs actuals and top keyword movements with trend arrows.
Each week is a record the marketing team fills in and management approves.

reseller.caption: API keys per reseller with margin and last sync time. Keys are generated server-side.
A key: allowed categories, hide-prices switch, global or per-category profit margin, extra fields to expose.

designer.caption: Designers board: live availability, active jobs, revisions and done count, with one-click Assign.
Performance: monthly work units done vs requested, revisions, on-pace projection, per-designer right-first-time.
Requests from sales: type, complexity, work units, assigned designer and status.

enquiries.caption: Monthly enquiry KPIs vs last month, on-pace projection and the live open pipeline by stage.
12-month trends with a forecast for the coming months.
The enquiry register that replaced the Excel sheet.

seo.caption: Daily SEO log: who did what, for which brand, with links, attachments and time spent.

tasks.caption: Task board: Kanban by status with department, priority, deadline and overdue flags.
Performance report by department and assignee.

reports.caption: Over-stocked & non-moving: pieces on hand, stock value, sales in period and months of stock, by brand.
Best moving products for the period, with stock on hand and months of cover.
Best profit products: invoiced sales minus average purchase cost.

sheet.caption: The marketing plan as a live spreadsheet inside Odoo: frozen columns, cell colours, formula bar, and row and column tools, with .xlsx import and export.

retention.caption: Call-back dashboard: who has been called, responses and follow-ups due.
Client contact list with call status, response and next follow-up.
Call history: every status, response or comment change is logged automatically.

artwork.caption: Brands with their gallery URL and artwork count.
The client-facing page is private: clients sign in with a one-time code sent to their company email (or a manager-issued passkey).
Signed in, the client sees only their own brand's approved artwork, headed by its logo.

garage.caption: Control centre: every area of the ERP from one home screen.
Job cards across the 12-stage workflow, from intake to handover.
A job card in repair WIP: the stage bar runs from intake to handover, with tabs for inspection, the estimate, parts allocation and workshop execution.
Executive BI: sales, purchases, VAT payable, profit, forecasts and the workshop pipeline.
Vehicle master with VIN, plate, owner and mileage.
